verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's own desktop page directly markets a full Ubuntu terminal environment running inside Windows via Windows Subsystem for Linux. It names development uses including web app development, AI/ML tooling, cross-platform apps and infrastructure management, all without leaving Windows. The evidence is marketing-level only. Missing for 10: step-by-step setup or usage documentation for Ubuntu on WSL, evidence for host OSes other than Windows, independent or hands-on corroboration that the environment works for development.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a full Linux terminal environment inside another host OS for development and tooling

citations.quote: The power of a full Ubuntu terminal environment on Windows with Windows Subsystem for Linux. Streamline web application development, run cutting-edge AI/ML tooling, develop cross-platform applications, and manage IT infrastructure - all without leaving Windows.
